title: Persistent Kth Smallest
statement:
Build persistent prefix frequency trees to answer static kth-smallest queries over subarrays.

Input
n q, then n signed values and q lines L R k with inclusive 1-based boundaries and 1 ≤ k ≤ R−L+1.

Output
Print the kth smallest value including duplicates for each query.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 200000. Each value has absolute value at most 10⁹. 1 ≤ q ≤ 200000.
